scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.db:migrate: npm run prisma --prefix server -- migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: npm run prisma --prefix server -- migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm run prisma --prefix server -- db seed
scripts.db:reset: npm run prisma --prefix server -- migrate reset
